candidate_decisions.reason: The upgrade note declares the removal.
candidate_decisions.summary: Variable "retention_days" is removed, so every caller that sets it fails to plan.
candidate_decisions.suggested_fix: Restore `variable "retention_days"` in `variables.tf` with type `number` and default `30`.

findings.summary: Variable "public_access" defaults to true, so a caller that omits it gets a public queue policy.
findings.suggested_fix: Set the default of `variable "public_access"` in `variables.tf` to `false`.
